description: This file defines the interface for device guard implementations in PyTorch, including the DeviceGuardImplInterface class, related utility functions, and registration mechanisms. It manages device and stream switching, event handling, and device capabilities across different device types.

classes.name: c10::impl::DeviceGuardImplInterface
classes.description: Virtual interface for device guard implementations, providing methods for device and stream management, event handling, and device capabilities.

classes.name: c10::impl::NoOpDeviceGuardImpl
classes.description: Template class implementing a no-operation device guard for devices without real device management, such as CPU or Meta.

classes.name: c10::impl::DeviceGuardImplRegistrar
classes.description: Registrar class for registering device guard implementations.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the device type managed by this guard implementation.

methods.name: exchangeDevice
methods.description: Sets the current device to the specified device and returns the previous device.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the current device.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Sets the current device.

methods.name: uncheckedSetDevice
methods.description: Sets the device without error checking, suitable for destructors.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the current stream for a given device.

methods.name: getDefaultStream
methods.description: Returns the default stream for a device; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: getStreamFromGlobalPool
methods.description: Returns a stream from the global pool; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: getNewStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new stream for a device; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: exchangeStream
methods.description: Sets the thread-local current stream for a device and returns the previous stream.

methods.name: destroyEvent
methods.description: Destroys an event; no-op in no-op implementation.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records an event in a stream; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Blocks until an event is completed; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of an event; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the number of devices; must not throw.

methods.name: getDeviceCapability
methods.description: Returns device capabilities; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: queryStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream has completed; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: synchronizeStream
methods.description: Synchronizes a stream; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes an event; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: synchronizeDevice
methods.description: Synchronizes all streams on a device; throws if unsupported.

methods.name: recordDataPtrOnStream
methods.description: Records a DataPtr on a stream for allocator awareness.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Returns elapsed time between two events; throws if unsupported.
